PC Errata 2017 slip of [[Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us]]: A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the type bar) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017). Source: Players Committee, ''Decipher Errata'' sheet (“Official text as of March 1, 2017”), [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf DErrata.pdf], PDF page 10; the PDF was made on 31 May 2017 (file metadata). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive] (5 July 2017; SHA-1 15433b18569a1d4cd69484e32f739227abfec972). Shown on [[Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].
